candidate_state: released from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, the optional opening-book feature, the self-play game-split unit tests, documentation and public-contract checks, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly release compilation, package generation, and generated JavaScript contract checks passed. Local Chrome execution was unavailable because the installed ChromeDriver returned HTTP 404; the GitHub CI browser job remains the publication gate.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.61.

known_limitations: The added search and Lazy SMP controls are disabled by default or retain the previous default values; this release makes no playing-strength claim for them.
The game-isolated split improves validation hygiene but does not itself train or adopt a stronger NNUE checkpoint.
No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
